Build the following as a small web app (TypeScript, HTML canvas, runnable with Vite — no frameworks):

A circle travels from point A (screen center) to point B (random point, 500–900px from A), starting slow and accelerating constantly toward B. On arrival, B becomes the new A and the process repeats; simultaneously a new circle spawns from the previous A. Each circle has its own color; color brightens with speed. Space pauses the simulation.

Deliver the complete project in one response: every file with its path, ready to run with npm install && npx vite. Do not ask clarifying questions — make reasonable choices and note them briefly at the end.

At the very end, if you have access to your own usage information, report the total tokens spent on this response (input and output). If you cannot access this, say "token count not available" — do not estimate.
